# Ultrabot

> Ultrabot builds AI voice agents with a talking face, in Hebrew and English: agents that answer from your documents with sources, act in your CRM and tools with approval, and speak on the web or the phone. Ultrabot is a product of MLAIA Data Science (https://www.mlaia.com/), led by Dr. Yochai Edlitz.

## Company

- **Name**: Ultrabot
- **Website**: https://ultrabot.ai/
- **Built by**: MLAIA Data Science (המלאיה מדעני נתונים בע״מ), Yavne, Israel
- **Languages**: Hebrew and English
- **Contact**: https://ultrabot.ai/#contact
- **Live demo**: https://talk.mlaia.com/ (voice, chat, cartoon, 3D and lifelike avatars)

## What we build

- [AI voice agents](https://ultrabot.ai/voice-agents/): streaming speech-to-text, an LLM with tools and natural speech, with low delay, barge-in, Hebrew support and phone integration.
- [Talking AI avatars](https://ultrabot.ai/avatars/): lip-synced faces driven by the agent's voice, from lightweight browser avatars to photoreal video.
- [AWS Bedrock agents](https://ultrabot.ai/aws-bedrock-agents/): agents inside your AWS account, with Guardrails, AgentCore, Lambda tools and least-privilege roles.
- [LangGraph agents](https://ultrabot.ai/langgraph-agents/): typed state, tool calling with limits, human approval steps, retries, tracing and step-level evaluation.
- [n8n automation](https://ultrabot.ai/n8n-automation/): workflows that connect forms, email, CRM and documents, with validated AI output, approvals and self-hosting.
- [Hebrew: צ'אט בוט וסוכן קולי AI לעסקים](https://ultrabot.ai/he/)
- [Hebrew: סוכנים קוליים](https://ultrabot.ai/he/voice-agents/) and [אווטארים מדברים](https://ultrabot.ai/he/avatars/)
